title: Calendar
summary: Full calendar app with left sidebar containing a mini date picker and event filter checkboxes color-coded by category. Main area shows a monthly calendar grid (March 2026) with colored event bars spanning multiple days. Right-side drawer for adding events with form fields. View toggle buttons for month/week/day/list.

layout.columns: Left sidebar (~20%) with date picker and filters, main calendar area (~60%), right drawer (~20%) for event form
